authorization.scope: Publish four evidence-bounded industry workflow case articles in the existing DSH Field Notes collection.

evidenceRules: Present the stories as workflow designs based on public fixed-Commit plugin capabilities, not as named customer deployments or measured outcomes.

State current DSH compatibility, installability, and runtime evidence separately; latest-window unknown remains unknown.
Disclose that scanned PDFs without a text layer require OCR outside the described plugin capability.
Keep procurement award, payment, accounting, maintenance execution, and legal conclusions under qualified human approval.
Do not imply DSH Desktop support: dsh-doc-toolkit is catalogued for the web profile; Desktop acceptance for both plugins remains unverified.
content.presentation: The article card category is 行业流程方案 so readers can distinguish designed workflows from documented customer deployments.

Validate unique article slugs, required metadata, bounded content size, fixed-Commit links, compatibility caveats, and case-evidence disclaimers.
Run npm run check and git diff --check.

Build the international and domestic static storefronts in separate disposable directories; verify the collection and all four new detail routes, canonical metadata, Article JSON-LD, and sitemap entries.
Verify exact file scope and ensure no DSH source, @deepseek-ai package, Catalog admission, author-contact state, or real Profile changed.
Submit through an auditable CI-checked pull request; after merge verify GitHub main, Pages manifest, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn independently.
